description: Stage 1 clinical diagnosis writeback cases for testing the CPRS multi-code diagnosis picker and C0FW Encounter/Condition filing path.

cases.title: Essential hypertension
cases.plausiblePatientHint: Older adult with outpatient history, blood-pressure monitoring, or cardiovascular risk factors.
cases.noteSupport: Sitting blood pressure is elevated at 145/92 mmHg with intermittent occipital headache; chronic hypertension management was reviewed.

cases.title: Type 2 diabetes mellitus
cases.plausiblePatientHint: Adult with chronic metabolic disease context, obesity, or prior glucose/HbA1c monitoring.
cases.noteSupport: Patient reports polyuria and polydipsia with obesity and elevated diabetes screening values; Type 2 diabetes support was documented.

cases.title: Community-acquired pneumonia
cases.plausiblePatientHint: Patient with recent acute outpatient or emergency-style respiratory encounter context.
cases.noteSupport: Fever, dyspnea, productive cough, leukocytosis, and pulmonary infiltrate support community-acquired pneumonia.

cases.title: Hypothyroidism
cases.plausiblePatientHint: Patient with chronic endocrine follow-up or medication-monitoring context.
cases.noteSupport: Lethargy, weight gain, cold intolerance, bradycardia, and thyroid laboratory pattern support hypothyroidism.

cases.title: Acute cystitis
cases.plausiblePatientHint: Patient with recent acute urinary complaint or outpatient urgent visit.
cases.noteSupport: Dysuria, urinary frequency, suprapubic pain, and abnormal urinalysis support acute cystitis.

cases.title: Hyperlipidemia
cases.plausiblePatientHint: Adult preventive-care patient with lipid screening or cardiovascular risk counseling.
cases.noteSupport: Preventive lipid screening shows elevated total cholesterol and LDL; patient remains asymptomatic.

cases.title: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
cases.plausiblePatientHint: Older adult with smoking history, chronic respiratory symptoms, or pulmonary medication context.
cases.noteSupport: Chronic cough, sputum production, exertional dyspnea, low oxygen saturation, and obstructive spirometry support COPD.

cases.title: Iron deficiency anemia
cases.plausiblePatientHint: Patient with lab-heavy history, fatigue complaints, or hematology follow-up context.
cases.noteSupport: Fatigue, generalized weakness, pallor, low hemoglobin, low ferritin, and microcytic indices support iron deficiency anemia.

cases.title: Acute appendicitis
cases.plausiblePatientHint: Patient with acute abdominal pain context or emergency-style visit.

selectedFindings.display: Abdominal pain localized to right iliac fossa

cases.noteSupport: Right lower quadrant pain, abdominal tenderness, nausea/vomiting, low-grade fever, and leukocytosis support acute appendicitis.

cases.title: Chronic kidney disease stage 3
cases.plausiblePatientHint: Patient with renal laboratory trend, hypertension, diabetes, or chronic medication-monitoring history.
cases.noteSupport: Reduced eGFR in the stage 3 range with elevated creatinine, nocturia, fatigue, and mild edema support CKD stage 3.

cases.title: Major depressive disorder, recurrent, moderate
cases.plausiblePatientHint: Patient with note history where behavioral-health-style symptom support would not look out of place.
cases.noteSupport: Depressed mood, insomnia, anhedonia, and moderate PHQ-9 score support recurrent moderate major depressive disorder.

cases.title: Acute gout flare
cases.plausiblePatientHint: Patient with acute joint pain context, prior gout, renal disease, diuretic exposure, or elevated uric acid history.
cases.noteSupport: Acute first metatarsophalangeal pain with erythema, joint swelling, and elevated uric acid supports acute gout flare.
